title: Eye-Catching Tea Packaging | MA 2022 Works Feature
description:
## Appreciation of works
### 1、CHALI CHINESE NATIONAL DRINK IN TANG DYNASTY GIFT BOX
The main visual style of the packaging is inspired by the Tang Dynasty mural "Golden Land and Green Landscape". The front of the teabag design is similar to a puzzle, which can be assembled into an illustration, the back is distinguished by large color blocks and horse-riding characters, vivid and unique, and the oriental romance in tea ology is fully displayed.

### 3、Tea Book
This Chinese tea package design uses books as the prototype of the package box to create the integration of books and tea and show the brand image of enjoyment from books and tea.

### 4、Teastan
The design has exemplified energizing teas on white packaging with a symbol of the Sun– a source of energy, and relaxing teas in black packaging with a symbol of the Moon.

## 7、EFUTON "ten consecutive championships" jenga tea
### 8、PUYU Instant Tea Package Design
The packaging design of this freeze-dried tea powder combines modern aesthetics to present an oriental aesthetic with the shape of the tea as a landscape.

### 9、Blanbunny Flower tea brick
The flower tea gift box is shaped like a delicate eyeshadow palette, with four different petal decorations, just like the four shades of the "eyeshadow palette", to meet the different tea drinking needs of delicate and beauty-conscious ladies. The exquisite packaging structure of the eyeshadow palette also allows you to place some single colour eyeshadows and DIY your own eyeshadow palette when the tea is finished.

## ![Chun Feng Shi Yang Ju](https://static.foodtalks.cn/image/post/22d1709ce5304c60715e7361826cee9d.jpg)
Moreover, the outer packaging box simulates a medicine box with additional graphics representing Chinese classical cultures such as seals, paper-cut for window decoration, and ruyi patterns. The packaging colors are mainly selected from traditional Chinese colors, using bright contrasting colors and more fashionable image processing methods.

### 12、CHALI BLACK LABEL OOLONG TEA
CHALI BLACK LABEL OOLONG TEA is packaged with a gold embossed illustration of the four major oolong-producing regions in China. The outer box is reverse frosted, the whole box looks smooth but has a delicate frosted texture when touched, with the silver card refracting light at different angles, the whole Black Label Oolong is fully qualified. The front pattern and map of the gift box have been embossed and convex, giving the image a more three-dimensional feel and a vivid image. It adopts an italic clamshell structure, and the tea bag is placed in a gradient shape at the bottom of the gift box at a slope angle.

### 16、The collection of health tea named CONGQIANMAN
The outer box is made from a natural texture of cotton-like paper, with a simple silver foil reflecting the texture of the original paper, amplifying a sense of security while blending a sense of sophistication and simplicity. The simplicity of the outer box is in sharp contrast with the full layered colors of the inner bag. The innovative outer box tumbler design allows the entire tea package to be easily attached to a home or office water dispenser, transforming the box into a slim and textured tea bin drawer that can be easily opened and closed to take tea.

### 17、CHALI RED MANSION TEA GIFT BOX
The gift box design uses the classical empty window aesthetics and is accompanied by modern bronzing technology, which is exquisite and generous.

### 19、T9 ROYAL COLLECTION
In the outer box, the combination of fine lines and craftsmanship creates a rich sense of sophistication. The lid with the golden three-dimensional Logo, the golden inner bag, all the details make this packaging luxurious in appearance.
